decisions.reason: The LHD loader was launched only a year ago into a long-cycle mining equipment market where sales take years to materialize, so its value is still highly uncertain, and it fits the firm's core underground competence and shares its engineering and service base, which keeps the cost of holding the option low.

The underground dump truck complements the loader in a typical mining fleet and uses shared platforms and service infrastructure, so keeping it open costs little while the one year of evidence is too early to show it cannot realize its value.
